about: iHC-Press news artwork assets for Google Flow (Nano Banana 2.1). Every image is text-free: the Thai headline, tags and credits are laid on top by tools/news-art (HTML template + Noto Sans Thai), because Flow garbles Thai letters. Full prompt = style + item.prompt + suffix (one line).
style: Cinematic semi-realistic 3D render for a premium Thai technology and computer news outlet, editorial key visual, deep black studio background, dramatic brand red #C81E23 rim and accent lighting with crisp white highlights, glossy reflective materials, high detail, shallow depth of field, cohesive black white and red color palette.
suffix: No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand names, no watermark, no readable screen content, full-frame image edge to edge with no black letterbox bars.
